cases.profile: We provide consumer wedding photography only. We do not operate laboratories or perform chemical assays.
cases.rubric: Explicit unrelated experience, no rescue questions, no claimed laboratory performance.

documents: Perform maintenance and calibration of surgical sterilizers. Relevant experience includes documented temperature and pressure calibration by the performing entity.
cases.profile: We service mechanical equipment. Our project descriptions and calibration history have not been supplied.
cases.rubric: Missing history is unknown, not positive experience or demonstrated inability. No clarification question about the explicitly absent history or a non-existent reference; retain missing proof as a gap. READY is understanding status, not established fit.

documents: Deliver refrigerated specimens in validated cold-chain containers. In this package QA means quality assurance. Retain continuous temperature logs and documented excursion handling. Prior delivery of this exact service is relevant. No contract vehicle is required.

This is a supplied claim, not independently verified. We prefer either prime or subcontract roles, but no current partner is proposed.

documents: Issued paving scope: reopen the runway 12 hours after concrete placement. Issued acceptance schedule: keep the same runway closed until 72 hours after concrete placement. Both apply to the same work; no order of precedence is supplied.

cases.rubric: Both reopening times retained, official conflict explicitly unresolved. No user preference may settle it.

documents: Provide veterinary diagnostic laboratory services. Evaluate the actual offeror's prior diagnostic work, not an affiliate's work unless the proposal establishes an authorized performance role.
